title: KB remapping does not reliably work

status.label: Retest the Ctrl+/ mapping on a current build
status.detail: The author says Ctrl+. and Ctrl+, work but Ctrl+/ to Ctrl+X does not on 0.91.1. A commenter adds a separate Ctrl+Shift+K/L text-sequence symptom; neither has a current-build retest.

judgment.rationale: The author’s concrete report is that Ctrl+. and Ctrl+, mappings work but Ctrl+/ to Ctrl+X does not on PowerToys 0.91.1. A commenter later describes a distinct case where two Ctrl+Shift text mappings produce the wrong second letter when Ctrl and Shift remain held. These symptoms may share shortcut-state handling, but the comment does not establish a common cause. Ask the author to retest the original Ctrl+/ mapping on a current build and record the keyboard layout and exact captured key before combining or designing fixes.
evidence: The issue lists PowerToys 0.91.1 and Windows 11 build 22631.0 with US English locale.
The author maps Ctrl+. to Ctrl+C and Ctrl+, to Ctrl+V successfully, but says Ctrl+/ to Ctrl+X does not work.
A commenter reports a separate Ctrl+Shift+K/L-to-text sequence issue while holding modifiers.
The issue is open, has one comment, and has no assignee.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a current-build retest of the author’s Ctrl+/ mapping with the exact source/target row and active keyboard layout; keep the commenter’s sequence separate unless independently confirmed.

fix_assessment.rationale: The failure is reported only on 0.91.1, the exact captured slash key/layout is not shown, and the commenter’s sequential text symptom may be separate. Establish a current reproduction before proposing a code change.

issue_context.summary: On PowerToys 0.91.1, Ctrl+. and Ctrl+, mappings work, but Ctrl+/ mapped to Ctrl+X reportedly fails.
known_information: The author lists Windows 11 build 22631.0, English (United States) language/system locale, and non-elevated per-user installation.
The author says Ctrl+. to Ctrl+C and Ctrl+, to Ctrl+V work, while Ctrl+/ to Ctrl+X does not.
A commenter describes a separate Ctrl+Shift+K/L text-remap sequence that emits the wrong second letter when modifiers remain held.
There is no current-build retest or assignee.
inferences: The failed slash mapping may depend on how the active layout captures the slash key, while the commenter’s sequential text issue may involve a different state transition.
issue_context.analysis: The original failure is narrow enough for a targeted current-build retest. Record the exact source key and layout, and do not treat the later commenter’s behavior as the same defect without confirmation.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue body and sole comment, separating the author’s Ctrl+/ failure from the commenter’s held-modifier text sequence.
Confirmed the reported build is 0.91.1 and no current-build reproduction is present.

information_gaps.information: Whether the Ctrl+/ to Ctrl+X mapping still fails on PowerToys 0.100.2 or newer.
information_gaps.why_needed: The reported version is 0.91.1 and current behavior is not established.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Retest the saved mapping on the current build in a simple text editor.

information_gaps.information: The exact keyboard layout and source key captured for the slash trigger, including whether Shift is held.
information_gaps.why_needed: The visible slash character may be produced by different physical keys across layouts.

actions.label: Retest the Ctrl slash shortcut mapping

comment.body:
Thanks for the specific Ctrl+/ example. The report lists PowerToys 0.91.1 and shows Ctrl+. and Ctrl+, working while Ctrl+/ to Ctrl+X fails. Could you please:
1. Retest that exact mapping on PowerToys 0.100.2 or newer in a simple text editor and report whether it still fails.
2. Share a screenshot of the source/target row and note the active keyboard layout and whether Shift is held when entering `/`.
The later comment describes a different held-Ctrl+Shift text sequence, so keeping those results separate will help avoid conflating two behaviors.
